description: This file defines the CachePreWarmerInterface in Drupal, which specifies methods for prewarming cache services to prevent cache stampedes after cache clears.

classes.name: CachePreWarmerInterface
classes.description: Interface for cache prewarmers, defining methods to prewarm individual or all cache services to mitigate cache stampedes.

methods.name: preWarmOneCache
methods.description: Prewarms one PreWarmable service, returning TRUE if a cache was prewarmed.

methods.name: preWarmAllCaches
methods.description: Prewarms all PreWarmable services, returning TRUE if any cache was prewarmed.
